#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

const int MAX = 1000000000;

class SegmentTree {
public:
    vector<int> tree;
    vector<int> arr;
    int size;

    SegmentTree(int N) {
        size = N;
        tree.assign(4 * N, MAX);
        arr.assign(N, MAX);
    }

    int query(int l, int r) {
        if (r < 0) {
            return MAX;
        }
        return queryUtil(1, 0, size - 1, max(0, l), r);
    }

    int queryUtil(int n, int tl, int tr, int l, int r) {
        if (l > r) {
            return MAX;
        }
        if (tl == l && tr == r) {
            return tree[n];
        }
        int tm = (tl + tr) / 2;
        return min(queryUtil(2 * n, tl, tm, l, min(r, tm)),
                   queryUtil(2 * n + 1, tm + 1, tr, max(tm + 1, l), r));
    }

    void assign(int n, int val) {
        arr[n] = val;
        int tl = 0;
        int tr = size - 1;
        int a = 1;
        while (tl < tr) {
            int tm = (tl + tr) >> 1;
            if (n <= tm) {
                tr = tm;
                a = 2 * a;
            } else {
                tl = tm + 1;
                a = 2 * a + 1;
            }
        }
        tree[a] = val;
        a >>= 1;
        while (a > 0) {
            tree[a] = min(tree[2 * a], tree[2 * a + 1]);
            a >>= 1;
        }
    }

    int getVal(int i) {
        if (i < 0) {
            return MAX;
        }
        return arr[i];
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int N, k;
    cin >> N >> k;
    vector<vector<int>> interval(k + 1, vector<int>(2));
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        cin >> interval[i][0] >> interval[i][1];
    }
    interval[k][0] = 2 * N;
    interval[k][1] = 2 * N;

    int cur = 0;
    vector<SegmentTree> dp(2, SegmentTree(N + 1));
    dp[0].assign(0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
        for (int j = N; j >= 0; j--) {
            int val = dp[0].getVal(j - (interval[i][0] - cur));
            dp[0].assign(j, val);
        }
        cur = interval[i][1];
        int sz = interval[i][1] - interval[i][0];
        for (int j = N; j >= 0; j--) {
            int put[2];
            for (int z = 0; z <= 1; z++) {
                int twoSwaps = dp[z].query(j - sz, j);
                int oneSwap = dp[(z + 1) % 2].query(j - sz, j);
                int noSwap;
                if (z == 1) {
                    noSwap = dp[z].getVal(j);
                } else {
                    noSwap = dp[z].getVal(j - sz);
                }
                put[z] = min(twoSwaps + 2, min(oneSwap + 1, noSwap));
            }
            dp[0].assign(j, put[0]);
            dp[1].assign(j, put[1]);
        }
    }
    int ans = min(dp[0].query(N, N), dp[1].query(N, N));
    if (ans >= MAX) {
        cout << "Hungry" << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << "Full" << "\n" << ans << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
